falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern failed; August 2024 saw lower highs after initial bounce, so a breakout above pre-correction levels invalidates the analog and suggests V-shape recovery rather than bottoming process

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 15 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated fear/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 15 would indicate complacency returning, contradicting the bottom formation thesis where volatility remains elevated during base-building

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred during a rates-driven correction where yields eventually stabilized; a sharp renewed rally in bonds (yield collapse) would signal recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom, breaking the pattern's macro context
